# mergeah_standard_entity_rule (Resource)

Manage settings on an existing organization standard entity rule. Destroy stops management and leaves settings unchanged. inbound_action is retained when absent from GET responses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
resource "mergeah_standard_entity_rule" "example" {
  entity_type     = "EMAIL_ADDRESS"
  is_active       = true
  inbound_action  = "REDACT"
  outbound_action = "BLOCK"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_type` (String) Merge API field `entity_type`. Changes require replacement.
- `inbound_action` (String) Merge API field `inbound_action`.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Merge API field `is_active`.
- `outbound_action` (String) Merge API field `outbound_action`.

### Read-Only

- `defined_at` (String) Value reported by Merge: `defined_at`.
- `description` (String) Value reported by Merge: `description`.
- `detection_method` (String) Value reported by Merge: `detection_method`.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. See the Import section for its format.
- `region` (String) Value reported by Merge: `region`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergeah_standard_entity_rule.example 'EMAIL_ADDRESS'
```
